TP3.description: Pressure generated at the pneumatic panel.

H1.description: Pressure generated due to pressure drop when the discharge of the cyclonic separator filter occurs.

DV_pressure.description: Pressure drop generated when the towers discharge air dryers; zero indicates compressor operation under load.

Reservoirs.description: Downstream pressure of the reservoirs; should be close to TP3.

Motor_current.description: Current of one phase of the three-phase motor; approximately 0 A off, 4 A offloaded, 7 A under load, 9 A startup.

COMP.description: Electrical signal of the compressor air-intake valve; active when there is no air intake, indicating off or offloaded operation.

DV_electric.description: Electrical signal controlling the compressor outlet valve; active under load and inactive when off or offloaded.

Towers.description: Electrical signal identifying the active air-drying/draining tower; inactive means tower one, active means tower two.

MPG.description: Electrical signal responsible for starting the compressor under load when APU pressure falls below 8.2 bar; it activates COMP.

LPS.description: Electrical signal that detects and activates when pressure drops below 7 bar.

Pressure_switch.description: Electrical signal that detects discharge in the air-drying towers.

Oil_Level.description: Electrical signal that activates when oil level is below expected values.

Caudal_impulse.description: Pulse count representing the absolute amount of air flowing from the APU to the reservoirs.
